fiction.title: THRESHING DAY
fiction.author: Rebecca Yarros
fiction.description: Thirteen short stories, set in the Empyrean world, in which cadets compete to earn the bond of a dragon.

fiction.title: MISS WOLCOTT'S GHOST
fiction.author: Louise Penny
fiction.description: The 21st book in the Chief Inspector Gamache series. Mysteries from the past confound Gamache and his team’s murder investigation.

fiction.title: A MARRIED LITTLE CHRISTMAS
fiction.author: Abby Jimenez
fiction.description: A collection of three holiday novellas: “Sweater Weather,” “Stealing Christmas” and “Marry Little Christmas.”

fiction.title: THE FAMILY CROSS
fiction.author: James Patterson
fiction.description: The 36th book in the Alex Cross series. A family crisis and the D.C. underworld put the psychologist in a tight spot.

fiction.title: CHAIN REACTION
fiction.author: Lee Child and Andrew Child
fiction.description: The 31st book in the Jack Reacher series. Gen. Susan Turner needs Reacher’s help to solve the murder of a team member on covert duty.

nonfiction.title: IN THE SHADOW OF EIGHT
nonfiction.author: Collin Gosselin with Allie Kingsley Baker
nonfiction.description: A dark tell-all by one of the sextuplets from the reality TV series “Jon & Kate Plus 8.”

nonfiction.title: ANDY'S BRAVO SCRAPBOOK
nonfiction.author: Andy Cohen
nonfiction.description: The Emmy Award–winning host shares recollections and photographs from reality TV over two decades.

nonfiction.title: WTF AMERICA?!
nonfiction.author: Ben Meiselas, Brett Meiselas and Jordy Meiselas
nonfiction.description: The founders of the independent news network MeidasTouch give their take on our current political and social climate.

nonfiction.title: AMERICA'S GOLDEN AGE
nonfiction.author: Newt Gingrich
nonfiction.description: The former speaker of the House prognosticates about the future of our country based on developments in technology and the actions of President Trump.

nonfiction.title: UNITING THE STATES
nonfiction.author: Brian Kilmeade
nonfiction.description: A co-host of “Fox & Friends” portrays contributions made by six key people around the time of the formation of our country.
